name: Branmarker
source:
Life was peaceful and leisurely on a fertile island. That all changed when monsters began infesting the island! The villages on this quiet island are being attacked, and the women are getting kidnapped! Soldiers, mercenaries, and knights have been sent to pursue, but none have returned. You play as a group of warriors, who must feel that their luck is better, and you must try and set things right for the islands people.

[From White Masq]
translation:
富饶岛屿上的生活原本宁静悠闲，直到怪物开始肆虐！这座安静岛屿上的村庄遭到袭击，女性居民也接连被掳走！士兵、雇佣兵和骑士受命追击，却没有一人归来。玩家将操纵一支相信自己运气更好的战士队伍，设法扭转局势，拯救岛上居民。

[摘自White Masq]
